methodology.selection_basis: Economic and business comparability to Qualcomm's fabless wireless, connectivity, edge and automotive semiconductor activities; sector membership alone is insufficient.
methodology.anchor_policy: Last valid observation on or before each calendar-year anniversary and on or before the research cutoff.
methodology.return_method: Cumulative price return: end adjusted-price observation divided by start adjusted-price observation minus one.
methodology.vintage_limitation: The provider response was retrieved after the cutoff and does not provide a historical-vintage guarantee. Calculations use no observation dated after the cutoff and make no claim that later vendor revisions are detectable.

entities.name: NXP Semiconductors N.V.
entities.rationale: Fabless automotive, edge and connectivity semiconductor exposure provides direct context for Qualcomm's diversification beyond handsets.

entities.name: MediaTek Inc.
entities.rationale: Closest approved economic comparator in mobile application processors, modems and connectivity; its Taiwan listing requires a defensible USD-comparable series.

entities.name: Broadcom Inc.
entities.rationale: Wireless, RF, connectivity and high-value semiconductor IP overlap, qualified by its material infrastructure-software exposure.

entities.name: Texas Instruments Incorporated
entities.rationale: Analog and embedded breadth, internal manufacturing and industrial exposure make consolidated economics insufficiently comparable.

entities.name: Analog Devices, Inc.
entities.rationale: Analog and mixed-signal focus, end markets and manufacturing economics differ materially from Qualcomm's platform, modem and licensing model.

entities.name: iShares Semiconductor ETF
entities.rationale: Approved semiconductor-sector benchmark; computationally separate from economic peers.

series.unavailable_reason: No defensible frozen USD-comparable MediaTek return series was acquired; no proxy or substitute is used.
